author: Salem Techsperts
description: The Framework Laptop 13 Pro is the laptop industry's biggest nightmare. When an upgradeable laptop eventually goes mainstream, it will benefit CONSUMERS. Framework is a right-to-repair focused company that has put their money where their mouth is. Now it's up to the people that can afford this tech to support them so they can achieve their goal of making a low-cost device for the mass-market.
title: Framework Laptop 13 Pro is BEST Laptop Ever Made? #tech #technology #computer #shorts #pc
